deliberateOmissions: Manchester United away (2–3, 19 September): the Gerrard comeback and Berbatov hat-trick were considered. The return match has a Liverpool hat-trick and January has Dalglish’s return; the selection retains those distinct United stories rather than expanding every rivalry fixture.
Blackpool home, Wolves home and other league defeats: Northampton, Goodison and Hodgson’s final match already represent distinct points in the early crisis.

Dalglish’s first home match against Everton and first league win at Wolves: meaningful transition context, but the FA Cup return and fourth consecutive win at Chelsea provide the strongest separate match stories.
Birmingham 5–0: Maxi’s first hat-trick is useful context for Fulham, whose away five-goal performance and Carragher milestone make it the stronger standalone selection.
Braga’s scoreless second leg: the European exit belongs in whole-season context; no standalone report is selected solely to complete competition coverage.
